_meta.description: Forward map: Roman/Latin → Bengali-Assamese script for Bishnupriya Manipuri (BPM)

structure.warning: This file's top-level keys are CONTRACT with the engine and REST layer. Do not rename, add, or remove sections without updating all four hardcoded locations: SECTION_ORDER in assets/js/engine.js, both flatten_map() call arrays in includes/class-engine.php (forward and reverse), the $sections array in includes/class-rest.php, and SECTION_LABELS in assets/js/admin.js.

section_roles.independent_vowels: Stand-alone vowel characters used at word/syllable start or after another vowel. Engine emits these directly with no virama logic.
section_roles.consonants: All consonant tokens. The engine builds the consonants_set from this section to drive virama insertion and inherent-vowel logic. Every entry here is treated as a consonant for cluster handling — do not put diacritics or punctuation here.
section_roles.matras: Vowel diacritics (dependent vowel signs) applied after a consonant. The engine builds the matras_set from this section. 'o' → '' (empty string) is the inherent-vowel suppressor and must be present. Also includes conjunct helpers: y/Y → ্য, ' → ZWJ.
section_roles.special: Standalone diacritics and modifier symbols: chandrabindu (ঁ), visarga (ঃ), anusvara (ং), hasanta+ZWJ (্‌). These are not consonants and must not be in the consonants section, or the engine will incorrectly apply virama logic after them.
section_roles.punctuation: Sentence punctuation and typographic symbols. Multi-character tokens (e.g. '..') must appear before their single-character prefix ('.') within this section so longest-match wins.

format_rules.pair_format: Each section is an ordered array of [from, to] pairs. Both elements must be strings.
format_rules.match_priority: The engine applies longest-match-first scanning across the entire flattened map. Within the same token length, the order of pairs inside each section — and the order of sections in SECTION_ORDER — determines which match wins. Put longer/more-specific tokens before shorter/generic ones within each section.
format_rules.longest_first_rule: Multi-character aliases (e.g. 'rri', 'OI', 'OU', 'aa', 'ssh', 'kkh') must appear before any single-character token that shares a leading character. Failure to do so causes the shorter token to consume the input first.
format_rules.duplicate_keys: Multiple pairs with the same 'from' key are allowed and useful for aliases (e.g. 'a' and 'aa' both → আ). Only the first match encountered during scanning wins, so place the preferred canonical form first.
format_rules.unicode_escapes: Use actual Unicode characters in 'to' values where possible for readability. \u200C (ZWJ) and \u09CD (virama) are exceptions where escapes are clearer.

engine_contract.consonants_set: Built by section_keys(map, 'consonants') in PHP and sectionKeySet(map, 'consonants') in JS. Used to decide whether to insert virama before a following consonant and whether the inherent vowel 'o' should be suppressed.
engine_contract.matras_set: Built by section_keys(map, 'matras') in PHP and sectionKeySet(map, 'matras') in JS. Used to decide whether a token following a consonant is a dependent vowel sign.
engine_contract.context_next_token_in: Snippet rules may reference section names via this field. Valid values are the six required_sections names above. A section name not in the required list will silently return an empty set and the condition will never fire.

changelog.4.0: Restructured sections. Moved : and ^ from consonants to special. Added s` → স and f → ফ to consonants. Added ee/oo aliases to independent_vowels. Dropped NON_JOINING as a separate group — entries already covered by consonants and special. Expanded _meta into a structural contract.
changelog.3.0: Merged phoneticMap.js ruleset. Added ssh/kkh/t``/t'' consonants, OI/OU/rri/aa/A/ee/oo vowel aliases, o-matra as empty string, y/Y matras, ZWJ apostrophe matra, ,, hasanta+ZWJ. Revised ng/s/r/y consonant targets.
